text:
Added profile picture support and displayed avatars next to names on posts and comments.

What changed:
- Added `profile_picture_url` to users in the database schema.
- Extended signup/login/user APIs to store and վերադարձ the profile picture URL.
- Updated post and comment queries/responses to include author avatar data.
- Added avatar/chip rendering helpers in `public/common.js`.
- Updated the signup form to let users enter a profile picture URL.
- Updated post/profile pages and styles to show avatars next to names.

Note:
- I used a profile picture URL field rather than a file-upload flow, since the app currently doesn’t have multipart upload handling or file storage set up.
